articles.title: Indian Army drops colonial-era dress customs; brings in Bandis, battlejackets under new uniform code
articles.summary: The Indian Army has undertaken significant reforms, removing several colonial-era vestiges from its dress regulations. This includes ending the mandatory carriage of swords by Reviewing Officers and the use of pouch belts with specific mess dresses. This move aligns with a broader national effort to shed colonial symbols, reflecting a commitment to national identity and modernizing military traditions.

articles.title: Southern Railway highlights 2025-26 achievements; rollout includes Amrit Bharat and MEMU services
articles.summary: Southern Railway announced significant achievements from the last financial year, including a major expansion of services across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka. This highlights crucial infrastructure development and enhanced connectivity in the southern region. Such railway expansion is vital for economic growth, passenger mobility, and efficient freight transport, directly contributing to national progress and regional integration.

articles.title: UK forces intercept Russian vessel in English Channel
articles.summary: British forces, including Royal Marine commandos, intercepted a sanctioned Russian oil tanker in the English Channel. This action targeted a vessel from Russia's "shadow fleet," operating despite international sanctions. The interception by the UK Ministry of Defence highlights ongoing efforts to enforce international law and economic restrictions against Russia, impacting its maritime operations and strategic interests in European waters.

articles.title: Ageing An-32 crashes, takes lives of 5 onboard IAF personnel
articles.summary: An Indian Air Force (IAF) An-32 transport aircraft tragically crashed while landing at Jorhat, Assam, on Saturday morning. The incident resulted in the loss of five onboard personnel, including two officers. This accident underscores the operational risks faced by defence personnel and highlights the ongoing need for maintenance, modernization, and stringent safety protocols for ageing military fleets to ensure optimal operational readiness.
